entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3680103286893920768: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.7154 +/- 0.0401 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 148.91 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -108.293, 10.635 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.32 +/- 0.07 solar radii from Adams et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of EPIC 228836835 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021PSJ.....2..152A/abstract). Mass 0.418179 +/- 0.020881 solar masses from TICv8, the stellar mass of EPIC 228836835 b's parameter set from TICv8 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract). Temperature 3782 +/- 152 K from Adams et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of EPIC 228836835 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,782 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffce9a. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 3,782 K and log g 5.05 (u1 0.177, u2 0.406): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
